protocol.roles: Base fit/checkpoint <=Oct29 or Dec29; next14 dates correction_fit, next14 calibration, next14 assessment. I210 winter transfers frozen autumn base.
protocol.residuals: Single chronological forward cross-fit; correction-fit labels were excluded from base fitting AND checkpoint selection. Not in-sample base residuals or a multi-fold CV claim.
protocol.basis: 12 clipped lawful features shared across all cells; 24 coefficients; frozen base; no truth residual as inference input
protocol.primary: Highest calibration official State, tie baseline then smaller strength
protocol.joint: Smallest cal observed full-coverage inventory-increment L1; State>=base AND >=primary-.001
protocol.scope: Complete targets on all selected dates. State official RMSE/regime/family hierarchy on 2/10 directions; not a ten-direction competition score.
protocol.assessment: Previously used public development calendar; no hidden labels, no assessment parameter tuning
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 circular paired calendar-date blocks of7, recompute nonlinear pooled regime macro; exclude draws missing regime
protocol.gate: State gain>=.002, pooled 95%lower>0, every direction gain>=-.001, both seasons; proxy alone cannot promote
